definition.description: Converts between CSV and JSON formats. Encode mode converts JSON array to CSV, decode mode converts CSV to JSON array.

inputFields.helpText: 'toJson' converts CSV to JSON array. 'toCsv' converts JSON array to CSV.
For toJson: CSV text. For toCsv: JSON array of objects.
CSV delimiter character. Default is comma.
Whether the first row contains column headers (for CSV) or should include headers (for JSON to CSV).

outputParameters.description: The converted output (JSON string or CSV text)
JSON array of column headers (CSV to JSON only)
